description: Finish funding a packet from your own wallet: pass the workId, your funderWallet, and xPayment — the standard X-PAYMENT header value (x402 exact scheme, an EIP-3009 USDC authorization on Base) that YOUR wallet built and signed against the challenge prepare_funding returned. This tool forwards it, unchanged, to the same public funding door any HTTP client uses (POST /nurture/fund) and returns that door's own answer. It holds no key, takes no payment itself, and marks nothing funded: the door settles the payment and only a verified settlement stamps a packet funded. Without xPayment it refuses and points you back to prepare_funding. A packet whose claim lane is closed is refused before any challenge, in plain words. If the door times out, do NOT pay again: read work_status first.

contributeUsd.description: Optional. The same EXPLICIT contribution you passed to prepare_funding; it must match the amount you signed.

funderWallet.description: The 0x… address that signed the payment. The ADDRESS only, never a private key.

workId.description: The packet id, from funding_quote or find_work.

xPayment.description: The X-PAYMENT header value your own wallet built and signed for the exact accepts[] terms from prepare_funding. Required; this server cannot create it.

name: submit_funding
title: Send your signed payment to the funding door (step 3 for a buyer)
